HellRaisers is a Ukrainian esports organization that is named after a Counter-Strike mixteam. Originally founded from the ashes of the former Astana Dragons team, they haved hosted teams in Counter-Strike: Global Offensive, Dota 2, and Rainbow Six, among other titles.

  • March 9th - HellRaisers is formed by former Astana Dragons players AdreN, ANGE1, Dosia, markeloff, and kucher. [1]
  • September 8th - HellRaisers part ways with AdreN. [2]
  • September 17th - s1mple joins. [3]
  • January 14th - HellRaisers replace s1mple and markeloff with AdreN and flamie. [4]
  • March 16th - HellRaisers part ways with flamie. [5]
  • March 30th - HellRaisers add mou. [6]
  • June - lmbt moves to a coaching role after serving as the team's manager.
  • September 11th - Dosia leaves. [7]
  • September 13th - s1mple steps in for HellRaisers as the active stand-in. [8]
  • October 6th - AdreN and mou's contracts expire; HellRaisers sign oskar and STYKO as replacements. [9]
  • October 22nd - s1mple will no longer be a stand-in for HellRaisers. [10]
  • January 8th - HellRaisers announce they will be using Zero instead of schneider as a stand-in for the upcoming European Minor Qualifiers [11]
  • March 7th - kUcheR leaves the team upon his contract expiring, smike joins as an official stand-in. [12]
  • March 16th - queztone replaces smike as a stand-in for the team. [13]
  • March 31st - HellRaisers bring in ami as an analyst. [14]
  • April 11th - Zero becomes an official member of the team. [15]
  • April 20th - queztone announces that his trial with HellRaisers has come to an end, and he won't be signing with the team. [16]
  • April 21st - bondik joins. [17]
  • June 7th - Johnta is brought in as a Sports Director for the team. [18]
  • June 16th - lmbt steps down from his coaching role and is replaced by Johnta. [19]
  • June 27th - oskar steps down from the starting line-up due to a forward contract with another team. [20]
  • August 22nd - oskar joins mousesports. [21]
  • September 14th - DeadFox replaces smike as a stand-in. [22]
  • October 5th - HellRaisers announce the signing of DeadFox. [23]
  • August 8th - STYKO joins mousesports. [24]
  • August 11th - ISSAA and woxic join on trial basis. bondik is placed on the transfer list. [25]
  • September 13th - After a month of trial, woxic officially joins HellRaisers. [26]
  • September 29th - bondik is loaned to TyLoo. [27]
  • October 19th - Zero steps down from the active lineup, FejtZ joins as a stand-in. [28]
  • October 20th - ISSAA becomes a permanent member of HellRaisers. [29]
  • December 25th - Zero is released from the organization. [30]
  • January 5th - bondik returns to the team after his loan to TyLoo expires. [31]
  • January 17th - HellRaisers return bondik to active line-up and remove FejtZ. [32]
  • November 8th - Hobbit officially joins the team, bondik becomes a free agent. [33]
  • December 22nd - ami becomes the new coach, Johnta becomes a free agent. [34]
  • March 8th - Magician becomes the new CEO of HellRaisers, As a result, xaoc is released from the organization. [35]
  • March 14th - woxic is acquired by mousesports. [36]
  • March 17th - HellRaisers sign oskar and lmbt, bench DeadFox, and release ami. [37]
  • March 28th - HellRaisers add loWel on trial. [38]
  • April 5th - HellRaisers acquire loWel from Movistar Riders. [39]
  • April 15th - nukkye joins HellRaisers, Hobbit is transfer listed. [40]
  • September 4th - HellRaisers bench their CS:GO roster due to disappointing performance at the StarLadder Berlin Major 2019. Additionally, they release DeadFox. [41]
  • September 8th - HellRaisers part ways with lmbt. [42]
  • September 20th - HellRaisers announce a revamped lineup consisting of ANGE1, nukkye, Flarich, crush, and scoobyxie. [43]
  • October 7th - Hobbit is loaned to Winstrike Team. [44]
  • October 15th - oskar becomes a free agent. [45]
  • October 17th - Lk- joins HellRaisers as coach. [46]
  • October 19th - loWel is acquired by Movistar Riders. [47]
  • December 4th - ISSAA is acquired by OG. [48]
  • January 10th - HellRaisers replace scoobyxie with AiyvaN. [49]
  • April 2nd - HellRaisers bench nukkye, Flarich, and AiyvaN; ANGE1, crush and Lk- are released. [50]
  • April 13th - HellRaisers part ways with nukkye. [51]
  • April 26th - HellRaisers announce their new roster: Flarich returns to the starting line-up; ProbLeM, jR, kAliNkA, JIaYm join; TsaGa becomes the new coach. [52]
  • June 8th - Team Unique acquire AiyvaN. [53]
  • July 6th - Hobbit becomes a free agent and leaves HellRaisers. [54]
  • January 18th - HellRaisers transfer list jR and add anarkez on a trial basis. [55]
  • February 17th - anarkez leaves HellRaisers. [56]
  • April 9th - HellRaisers disband their lineup: kAliNkA and TsaGa are released while Flarich, ProbLeM, and JIaYm are transfer listed. [57]
  • May 17th - jR is acquired by ONYX. [58]
  • July 10th - Flarich retires from Counter-Strike: Global Offensive as his contract with HellRaisers expires. [59]
  • December 8th - HellRaisers sign Templ, 7oX1C, w0nderful, alex666, OWNER, and liTTle as coach. [60]
  • January 16th - ProbLeM and JIaYm are acquired by GMT Esports. [61]
  • March 2nd - HellRaisers put their Counter-Strike: Global Offensive division on hold as a consequence of the Russian invasion of Ukraine. [62]
  • March 17th - HellRaisers release their lineup due to being unable to further support the team. [63]
